hypothesis: v52 proves the rank-32 pointer can alter autonomous generation but over-copies because its positive gate label is merely target-present-in-prompt. Restricting positive labels to target-present-in-prompt AND frozen-parent-top1-wrong will teach prompt carriage only at positions with a measured parent deficit, preserving already-correct open-ended English while repairing nonce identity.

single_changed_mechanism.v52_positive_gate_label: response target token occurs anywhere in prompt
single_changed_mechanism.v53_positive_gate_label: response target token occurs in prompt and frozen parent teacher-forced top-1 token is not the target
single_changed_mechanism.reason: mixture likelihood independently rewards copying any overlapping prompt token and would conflict with selective labels

evaluation_order: focused tests and bounded CUDA stress with exact parent-state verification
CPU natural screen requiring at least 9 of 28, zero collapse, and fewer regressions than v52
CPU 1,400-case suite requiring every capability at least 0.80, retention at least 0.90, and zero collapse
only after quality passes: exact native runtime and every speed, TTFT, RSS, identity, physical sparsity, and persistent-state gate
decision_rule: Reject without threshold, rank, loss-weight, or duration sweeps if the natural screen fails or does not reduce v52 regressions. If natural passes, require the complete functional gate before runtime work. A pass requires the same exact final checkpoint at all later gates.
